gaps.note: The data sheet lists Rack Mount Kit 590037 in the box (two rack ears with six M4 screws, four M5 caged nuts and four M5 x 15 mm rack screws). No held document dimensions the ears or says where they sit, and the photographs show the chassis without ears, so no ear or kit is modelled.
gaps.wanted: The installation guide for rack mount kit 590037.

gaps.note: The data sheet gives the dimensions and weight of CM8148-10G, CM8132-10G and CM8116-10G and says nothing of the -USB models. The base model's 440 x 265 x 44 mm is used and no weight is written.
gaps.wanted: The dimensions and weight of the CM8148-10G-USB.

gaps.note: The photograph shows four lamps (power, heartbeat, IOIO, network) and a green and an amber window on each RJ45 jack. No held document says what a lamp shows, so no state is written.
gaps.wanted: The quick start guide, with its LED table.

gaps.note: The data sheet states a typical and a maximum consumption for the unit and none for any one port or lamp, so none is stated for them.
The data sheet says the pinout of each serial port is software selectable, straight or rollover. No held document says how the setting is made, so the ports carry no pinout attribute.
gaps.wanted: The user guide section that sets the port pinout.

chassis.note: Data sheet, Dimensions and Weight: "CM8148-10G, CM8132-10G, and CM8116-10G" are 17.3 x 10.5 x 1.75 in, 440 x 265 x 44 mm, 1 RU. The data sheet does not name the -USB models in that row, so the width, depth and height of the base model are used here; the rear photograph is as wide as the front one (1961 and 1722 px at their own scales, both 440 mm by the same method), which supports the width and says nothing of the depth. No weight is stated for the -USB models and none is written. The rack kit 590037 ships in the box but no source dimensions it, so the body is drawn alone.

front-layout.note: Method: the CM8148-10G-USB front photograph (2560 x 1440, no scale marker, a slight downward view that shows a strip of the top) is measured against the data sheet envelope. The face is 1722 px wide for 440 mm, 3.91 px/mm across; it is 164 px high for 44 mm, 3.73 px/mm down, so the face is foreshortened about 5 percent in height and the positions down the face are the less sure. The positions across are good to about 1 mm and the ones down to about 1.5 mm. The serial pitch (14.1 mm, 55.3 px) and the extra 3.7 mm (14.5 px) between the three groups of 16 are read on this face only.

lamps.note: The photograph prints four lamp windows with the power, heartbeat, IOIO and network symbols. No held document says what any lamp shows, so no state is written for a lamp or a jack window.

livery.note: The red border, the charcoal panel with its diagonal edge and two stripes, the white label tabs, the black serial frame and the wordmark are read off the photographs at the same scale and are painted livery, not parts. The logo mark is a simplified outline.

network.note: Data sheet: "2 x 10G SFP+ Fiber and 2 x 1000 Base-T Ethernet". The front photograph prints NET1 SFP+ over NET2 SFP+ on two stacked cages and NET3 over NET4 on two stacked RJ45 jacks, each jack with a green and an amber lamp window.

power.note: Data sheet: dual socket universal IEC C14 inlet, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz; every appliance ships with two C14 power cables. Power consumption, as printed: "CM8148-10G-USB: 21W (72 BTU/h) typical, 48W (164 BTU/h) maximum". The maximum is filed as `power-max-w`. The rear prints the numbers 1 and 2 with a plug symbol under each inlet.

rear-layout.note: Method as the front: the CM8148-10G-USB rear photograph is 1961 px wide for 440 mm (4.46 px/mm) and 191 px high for 44 mm (4.34 px/mm). The eight USB-C ports (pitch 16.05 mm, 71.5 px), the two C14 inlets and the printing are read off it, good to about 1 mm across and 1.5 mm down. The photograph shows the same rear as the CM8116-10G-USB one. The inlet openings in the photograph are smaller than the library's C14 part; the part is drawn as it is.

serial.note: Data sheet: CM8148-10G has 48 RJ45 RS-232 serial ports with a software selectable "Straight or Rollover" pinout, 50 to 230,400 bps. The pinout drawing prints, for the device ports, X1 "Cisco Rolled" (1 RTS, 2 DTR, 3 TxD, 4 GND, 5 CTS, 6 RxD, 7 DCD, 8 DSR) and X2 "Cisco Straight" (1 CTS, 2 DSR DCD, 3 RxD, 4 GND, 5 not connected, 6 TxD, 7 DTR, 8 RTS), and for the local console X1 with pins 2, 5 and 7 not connected. The photograph numbers the ports 1, 3 to 47 over 2, 4 to 48 in three groups of 16, with SERIAL printed between 23 and 25.

serial-role.note: The serial ports are console server ports. The CM8100-10G family data sheet, p.1, says of the family (not of this model alone): "Secure, remote, access to manage up to 96 serial devices". It also lists "IP alias for serial port console connections" under Console Management. The RJ45 console on the front is the local console (data sheet, p.1, "Console Port").

sides.note: The data sheet prints, p.2, "Passive Cooling - can be forward or reverse mounted to best suit airflow". It shows no top, bottom or side, so how those faces look is not stated; the vent slots drawn on the front and rear are read off those photographs.

sources.note: Opengear CM8100-10G High Density Console Manager data sheet (September 22, 2026): console specifications, interfaces, power requirements, physical dimensions, model table and package checklist. The CM8148-10G-USB front and rear photographs and the "Cisco Rolled" / "Cisco Straight" pinout drawing published with the family. No quick start, hardware guide or dimensioned drawing is held.

usb.note: Data sheet: two USB 3.0 ports, 900 mA per port. The photograph labels the two USB-A jacks A and B and prints the SuperSpeed mark under them, beside the CONSOLE RJ45 jack in one housing.

usb-serial.note: Data sheet: "CM8148-10G-USB and CM8116-10G-USB only: 8 x USB-C 2.0 for serial ports, 150 mA per port", and the model table "8 x rear USB-C 2.0 for serial ports". The rear photograph labels the eight ports A to H.
